blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator Mark Villar has joined the majority bloc of the Senate, according to Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri. Zubiri confirmed this after the Senate elected Villar as chairman of the Senate committee on public works and a member of the Commission on Appointments (CA) as part of the majority bloc. READ: Mark Villar resigns as DPWH secretary “Mr. President, pursuant to Section 18, Article 6 of the 1987 Constitution, I move that Senator Mark Villar be elected as a member of the Commission on Appointments vice Senator Juan Miguel Zubiri.
